name: omero-pos
description: Omero POS — Electron desktop wrapper (Next local en localhost:3000, proxy al backend de Railway)

scripts.prepare:app: npm run build:config && npm run fetch:native && npm run build:web && npm run prepare:frontend && npm run verify:native -- --module resources/frontend/node_modules/better-sqlite3
scripts.build: npm run prepare:app && tsc && npm run copy:html && electron-builder -c electron-builder.config.ts --publish never
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare:app && tsc && npm run copy:html && electron-builder --win -c electron-builder.config.ts --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare:app && tsc && npm run copy:html && electron-builder --mac -c electron-builder.config.ts --publish never
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
